# zerotier_v2_api_key (Resource)

An API key for a Central V2 service account. Central returns the key only when it is created, so it is kept in Terraform state; treat the state as secret. Change `expires` (or use `-replace`) to rotate it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zerotier_v2_api_key" "ci" {
  service_account_id = zerotier_v2_service_account.ci.id
  description        = "GitHub Actions"
  expires            = "2027-06-30T00:00:00Z"
}

# The key is only returned when it is created, and is stored in state.
output "ci_api_key" {
  value     = zerotier_v2_api_key.ci.key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expires` (String) When the key expires (RFC 3339, in the future). Changing it creates a new key.
- `service_account_id` (String) ID of the service account the key authenticates as.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description (up to 255 characters).

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String) When the key was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) API key ID.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The API key. Only available for keys created by Terraform, not imported ones.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The key itself cannot be imported; only its metadata.
terraform import zerotier_v2_api_key.ci <api key id>
```
